summary: VisionSys AI Inc filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting held June 26, 2026. Shareholders approved an increase in authorized share capital to US$260M by creating an additional 250B Class A ordinary shares and adopted amended articles to address voting rights, conversion rights, scripless shares, and a name change. A clerical error in Article 76 (listing ten votes per Class B share instead of the correct one hundred) was noted and will be corrected at the 2027 AGM. The filing is a routine post-meeting report with no special-situation event.
